queries.query: How long before scheduled departure must an airline inform passengers about a flight cancellation?
What options must an airline offer when passengers are informed about cancellation less than two weeks but at least 24 hours before departure?
What happens when passengers were not informed about cancellation as required or missed a connecting flight booked on the same ticket?
How do block time and booked one-way basic fare affect compensation for certain flight cancellations?
What happens if passengers did not provide adequate email or phone contact information when booking a cancelled flight?
When can extraordinary circumstances beyond the airline's control affect cancellation compensation?
Which other Civil Aviation Requirements govern refunds of air tickets?
What delay thresholds based on flight block time trigger passenger facilities for passengers who checked in on time?
What options must airlines offer if a domestic flight is expected to be delayed by more than six hours?
What facilities are specified for long delays and flights scheduled to depart between 2000 and 0300 hours?
When may an airline not be obliged to provide delay-related facilities because of extraordinary circumstances?
Who bears the burden of proving whether and when a passenger was informed about a flight delay?
What should an airline do first when more confirmed passengers report for a flight than there are available seats?
How does the timing of an alternate flight affect compensation after involuntary denied boarding?
What compensation provisions apply when an alternate flight departs within 24 hours, after 24 hours, or the passenger declines an alternate flight?
What applies when a passenger denied boarding on the first leg of a connecting journey reaches the final destination at least three hours late?
What reimbursement provisions apply when a passenger is involuntarily downgraded to a lower travel class?
Which compensation rules may apply to foreign carriers operating flights to or from India?
What payment methods are permitted for compensation under the specified denied boarding and cancellation provisions?
Which passenger facilities must be provided free of charge, including meals, refreshments and accommodation?
When may an affected passenger complain directly to the airline about missing compensation or passenger facilities?
How can passengers escalate an unresolved airline grievance through Air Sewa or a statutory body?
Who pays for transferring passengers between alternate and booked airports, and how does advance notice affect responsibility?
What information about refunds, compensation and passenger facilities must airlines display on their websites?
What grievance-handling officers must airlines appoint, and what information must they display on their websites?
